title: CARES: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Trustworthiness in Medical Vision Language Models

layout.note: Five rounded cards of unequal width: Trustfulness and Safety on the top row with the CARES logo between them, Fairness, Privacy and Robustness on the bottom row; one question bubble sits above the Trustfulness card. No arrows.

lesson: Give each evaluation dimension its own tinted card with an emblem, a yellow question bubble, a grey answer bubble and a tick or cross; colouring only the faulty or sound words of the answer shows the verdict without extra annotation.
